'''John McDaniel''' (also written '''John McDaniels''') was a Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 34 in the Dantooine region, from Lowell, AR.<ref name="decsq-dantooine" /><ref name="smlist" /> In July 2003 [[Guy Kargl]] named him as the tournament director of one of the seven events of the Vintage Stock Tour, a series of sealed-deck tournaments at Vintage Stock stores in Oklahoma, Arkansas, Kansas and Missouri.<ref name="pcf-1895-30304">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30304#30304 Vintage Stock Tour! Uncut Sheet Prizes! 7 tournaments!], Guy Kargl, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 July 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041101152255/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30301 Internet Archive]</ref> He won Matt Enlow Memorial Tournament #4 on 11 December 2004, 1st of six players, with the Dark Side.<ref name="pcf-4248-58346">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58346#58346 Matt Enlow Memorial Tournament #4 RESULTS], Guy Kargl, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 December 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050217013726/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58346%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
